steps.task: Every burner and cooking plate, one by one: a gas burner with its cap and grid, or a round flat cast-iron electric plate, and where it is on the hob; every knob, button, display and lettering. A burner or plate covered by something standing on it — a kettle — is told by what shows of it at its edges and by its knob: a flat dark ring with no grid over it is an electric plate, and so is one whose knob is numbered 1, 2, 3; a knob with a flame mark runs a gas burner. Never guess a covered one to be like the others.
Техника целиком, фронтально, на светлом фоне, без упаковочной плёнки. Двери и люки закрыты, панель управления видна. Мягкая тень под техникой.
